description.value: Perugia Italian Caffè is a UBC Food Services café inside the Life Sciences Centre on the UBC Vancouver campus, serving Italian-inspired meals prepared in-house. Specialties include roast chicken, sundried tomato salmon, classic pastas, flatbreads, soups, and Italian-style wraps and sandwiches. The café serves organic, locally-roasted Milano coffee and Fair Trade Tea, with take-out options suited to cyclists on the move.
